decision.reason: [ev-d53fb7a74526] is a one-line changelog entry. All it says is that the Loki logstash output client gained "structured metadata support", and for details it points to issue #10899 and commit 32f1ec2. It doesn't say which config option or behaviour is the subject, whether the feature is opt-in or on by default, or whether existing logstash output behaviour changes. That leaves the change type, applicability and consequence undetermined. We'd need the PR, commit diff or the logstash output plugin docs to write the typed assertion.
